cohort: 100 participants who underwent laparoscopic hysterectomies (LH) for benign gynecological diseases.
finding: The ERAS protocol significantly reduced post-operative nausea, vomiting, duration of gas discharge, length of hospitalization, analgesic requirements, and VAS pain scores compared to standard care in patients undergoing laparoscopic hysterectomies.
followup_time: Immediate post-operative period, up to 41.78 hours for hospitalization and 24 hours for pain scores.
